description: Remove one or more test cases from a suite. `tcIds` accepts ids or business keys; every occurrence of each is removed and the remaining test cases are reordered. Requires a live connection. Returns the updated suite with its test cases.

suiteId.description: The suite id to remove from.

tcIds.description: Test case ids / business keys to remove.

name: suite_remove_testcases
title: Remove test cases from a suite
